scenes.text: You probably picture the Sahara Desert as an endless, lifeless ocean of burning sand, but a sleeping green monster is waiting beneath.
Every twenty thousand years, the Earth wobbles slightly on its axis, changing how sunlight hits our planet and triggering massive monsoons.
This transforms the barren wasteland into a lush, tropical paradise filled with deep lakes, flowing rivers, and roaming wildlife.
Historically, humans hunted in this green Sahara, leaving behind rock art of hippos in places that are now bone-dry.
